teamperk:tpid_bioenergysource.name: Bio-Energy Source
teamperk:tpid_bioenergysource.description: Recover Shield equal to 0.2% of Energy lost.

teamperk:tpid_blakebeardsstash.name: Blakebeard's Stash
teamperk:tpid_blakebeardsstash.description: Eliminations have a 5% chance to uncover one of Blakebeard's stashes. Search them to find Peg Legs, Coconuts, and Cannonball Grenades.

teamperk:tpid_blastfromthepast.name: Blast from the Past
teamperk:tpid_blastfromthepast.description: Removes all shield and increases Max Health by 200%.

teamperk:tpid_boombase.name: BOOM-B.A.S.E.
teamperk:tpid_boombase.description: B.A.S.E. blasts Steel Wool music, increasing Damage by 12% and Critical Rating by 15 for allies within 5 tiles.

teamperk:tpid_coolcustomer.name: Cool Customer
teamperk:tpid_coolcustomer.description: With Stay Frosty active, using an ability reduces Cooldown of all abilities by 3 seconds and ends Stay Frosty.

teamperk:tpid_dangerdanger.name: Z.A.P.
teamperk:tpid_dangerdanger.description: Z.A.P. has your back, dealing 105 base Energy Damage to a random enemy every 6 seconds.

teamperk:tpid_dimmak.name: Dim Mak
teamperk:tpid_dimmak.description: Shadow Stance regenerates 1.8% Shield per second.

teamperk:tpid_endlessshadow.name: Endless Shadow
teamperk:tpid_endlessshadow.description: Increases Shadow Stance Duration by 4 seconds.

teamperk:tpid_holidaycheer.name: Happy Holidays
teamperk:tpid_holidaycheer.description: Reduces your Ability cooldowns by 40%. Stacks independently from other cooldown reduction perks.

teamperk:tpid_huntersinstinct.name: Hunter's Instinct
teamperk:tpid_huntersinstinct.description: Eliminations during Evening or Night grant 0.2% Damage and 0.1% Melee Life Leech, up to 40 stacks. These bonuses last until Night ends.

teamperk:tpid_keepout.name: Keep Out!!!
teamperk:tpid_keepout.description: Frag Grenade leaves an energized area dealing 18 base Energy Damage per second for 6 Seconds. Base Radius is 0.375 tiles and increases by 40% with each match.

teamperk:tpid_kineticoverdrive.name: Kinetic Overdrive
teamperk:tpid_kineticoverdrive.description: Kinetic Overload occurs an additional time.

teamperk:tpid_longarmofthelaw.name: Long Arm of the Law
teamperk:tpid_longarmofthelaw.description: Increases Anti-Material Charge Range by 1 tile(s).

teamperk:tpid_nevertellmetheodds.name: Underdog
teamperk:tpid_nevertellmetheodds.description: Increases Healing Received by 2.5% for each nearby enemy.

teamperk:tpid_onetwopunch.name: One-Two Punch
teamperk:tpid_onetwopunch.description: Your next Heavy Attack after using an ability costs 20% less Energy.

teamperk:tpid_phaseblaster.name: Phase Blaster
teamperk:tpid_phaseblaster.description: Every 5 seconds, your next shot will fire a Phase Pulse which deals 47 base Energy Damage.

teamperk:tpid_preemptivestrike.name: Preemptive Strike
teamperk:tpid_preemptivestrike.description: Increases Damage by 6.5% against full health enemies.

teamperk:tpid_recycling.name: Recycling
teamperk:tpid_recycling.description: B.A.S.E. generates resources based on affected structures. Higher tier structures generate more resources. Interact with B.A.S.E. to collect.

teamperk:tpid_roundtrip.name: Round Trip
teamperk:tpid_roundtrip.description: Throwing Stars return to you, dealing their damage again on the way back.

teamperk:tpid_shakeitoff.name: Shake It Off
teamperk:tpid_shakeitoff.description: Decreases Duration of elemental status effects by 50%.

teamperk:tpid_shiftinggears.name: Shifting Gears
teamperk:tpid_shiftinggears.description: Phase Shift has 1 additional charge(s) and Range is decreased by 0.2 tile(s).

teamperk:tpid_slowyourroll.name: Slow Your Roll
teamperk:tpid_slowyourroll.description: Freeze melee attackers for 2 second(s). Mist Monsters are slowed by 43%.

teamperk:tpid_superchargedtraps.name: Supercharged Traps
teamperk:tpid_superchargedtraps.description: Increases Damage of traps affected by B.A.S.E. by 8.5%.

teamperk:tpid_totallygnarly.name: Totally Rockin' Out
teamperk:tpid_totallygnarly.description: Rockin' Riff also increases Crit Rating by 160 (decaying over 8 seconds), and Heals 73.8 base health.

teamperk:tpid_trickandtreat.name: Trick and Treat
teamperk:tpid_trickandtreat.description: 50% chance to conjure an extra Phantasm every time you conjure one. In addition, Phantasms have 33% Life Leech.

teamperk:tpid_violentinspiration.name: Hot Swap
teamperk:tpid_violentinspiration.description: Weapon eliminations increase Weapon Damage by 13% for 15 seconds. Each weapon type can only apply one stack of this effect.

quest:betastormquest_completebetastorms_.name: Beta Storm Prospecting
quest:betastormquest_completebetastorms_.description: We're seeing some strange weather patterns in the area. Complete some Beta Storm missions, for Science (and Gold)!

objectives.description: Complete 2 Beta Storm missions

quest:birthday_quest_collectflamingos.name: Party Decor
quest:birthday_quest_collectflamingos.description: What's a party without some great decorations?

objectives.description: Collect flamingo lawn ornaments

quest:birthday_quest_collectice.name: Keepin' It Cool!
quest:birthday_quest_collectice.description: What better way is there to celebrate summer and beat the heat than kicking back with a cool drink? Go get some ice.

objectives.description: Destroy ice machines, freezers, or refrigerators to collect ice

quest:birthday_quest_collecttowels.name: Towel Off!
quest:birthday_quest_collecttowels.description: There's yet another soggy emergency on the pool deck! Find some towels!

objectives.description: Collect pool towels

quest:birthday_quest_harvestac.name: Beat the Heat
quest:birthday_quest_harvestac.description: This summer is a hot one and someone at Homebase broke the air conditioning! Collect air conditioning parts to cool everyone off.

objectives.description: Harvest air conditioner units to collect their parts

quest:birthday_quest_lightfireworks.name: Start the Show!
quest:birthday_quest_lightfireworks.description: Start the celebration and light off them fireworks!

objectives.description: Light off fireworks

quest:birthday_quest_mistmonsters.name: Misty Meddlers
quest:birthday_quest_mistmonsters.description: Those Mist Monsters always seem to want to crash our parties. Show them the door and take em' out!

objectives.description: Eliminate Mist Monsters of any type

quest:birthday_quest_rescuesurvivors.name: Cooling Off
quest:birthday_quest_rescuesurvivors.description: The heat wave is picking up. Bring in survivors so they can cool off and kick it with the rest of Homebase!

objectives.description: Rescue survivors

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killchromehu.name: Enter the Chrome Husky
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killchromehu.description:
Now that you have access to a Perk Recombobulator, eliminate as many Chrome Husky Husks as you can to earn PERK-UPs to power it. Note: This is a repeatable Quest.

The Perk Recombobulator feature is available after completing the Plankerton Storm Shield Defense 2 Quest.

objectives.description: Eliminate a Chrome Husky

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killfirehusk.name: When Fire Husks Start to Burn
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killfirehusk.description:
Now that you have access to a Perk Recombobulator, eliminate as many Fire Husks as you can to earn PERK-UPs to power it. Note: This is a repeatable Quest. Fire Husks can be found in Plankerton or higher areas.

The Perk Recombobulator feature is available after completing the Plankerton Storm Shield Defense 2 Quest.

objectives.description: Eliminate 300 Fire Husks

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killminiboss.name: One "Mini-Boss" at a Time
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killminiboss.description: Eliminate as many Epic Mini-Bosses as you can, Commander! Note: This is a repeatable Quest.

objectives.description: Eliminate an Epic Mini-Boss in a Mini-Boss mission

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killmistmons.name: Mist Monster Bash
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killmistmons.description:
Now that you have access to a Perk Recombobulator, eliminate as many Mist Monsters as you can to earn PERK-UPs to power it. Note: This is a repeatable Quest.

The Perk Recombobulator feature is available after completing the Plankerton Storm Shield Defense 2 Quest.

objectives.description: Eliminate 50 Mist Monsters

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killnaturehu.name: One with Nature Husks
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killnaturehu.description:
Now that you have access to a Perk Recombobulator, eliminate as many Nature Husks as you can to earn PERK-UPs to power it. Note: This is a repeatable Quest. Nature Husks can be found in Plankerton or higher areas.

The Perk Recombobulator feature is available after completing the Plankerton Storm Shield Defense 2 Quest.

objectives.description: Eliminate 300 Nature Husks

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killwaterhus.name: Don't Be Like Water Husks
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_killwaterhus.description:
Now that you have access to a Perk Recombobulator, eliminate as many Water Husks as you can to earn PERK-UPs to power it. Note: This is a repeatable Quest. Water Husks can be found in Plankerton or higher areas.

The Perk Recombobulator feature is available after completing the Plankerton Storm Shield Defense 2 Quest.

objectives.description: Eliminate 300 Water Husks

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_landmark_com.name: Space Rocks
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_landmark_com.description: We're closing in on the landing site. Search the zone for the crater, deploy scanning equipment, and get ready to fight!

objectives.description: Deploy and Defend Scanners

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_landmark_met.name: Meteoric Fall
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_landmark_met.description:
Chrome husks, earthquakes, we’d better destroy the meteorite before it strikes again. Stand by to deploy and defend our Anti-Meteorite Lasers.

Note: this quest cannot be completed until you complete "It came from Space!" quest.

objectives.description: Destroy The Meteorite

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_landmark_sui.name: Sharp Dressed Plan
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_landmark_sui.description: We’re ready to field test Spitfire’s suit. Deploy the suit in a combat setting, and prepare to fight.

objectives.description: Test The Suit

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_opencaches_r.name: Fortune and Glory
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_opencaches_r.description:
Now that you have access to a Perk Recombobulator, open as many caches as you can to earn PERK-UPs to power it. You can find caches in the world by killing Mini-Bosses or looting valuable treasure chests. Note: This is a repeatable Quest.

The Perk Recombobulator feature is available after completing the Plankerton Storm Shield Defense 2 Quest.

objectives.description: Open 10 Caches

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_bar.name: Ooze Control
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_bar.description: Spitfire is missing, and toxic waste barrels are popping up in unexpected places. Search the barrels and discover the connection.

objectives.description: Search Barrels

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_bee.name: The Powers That Bee
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_bee.description: Some heroes aren't born, they're made. Eliminate Bee Hive husks and collect corrupted beehive pieces for Lok's super experiment.

objectives.description: Eliminate Beehive Husks And Collect Corrupted Beehive Pieces.

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_bro.name: We Interrupt This Broadcast...
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_bro.description: The TVs around the world are broadcasting ominous messages. We need to investigate - destroy the TVs and collect corrupted receivers to understand what is happening. Something is corrupting the receivers, but it is not the storm. TVs are most often found in Suburban and Urban zones.

objectives.description: Collect Television Receivers

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_car.name: Carbon Dating
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_car.description: We should check to see if the chrome husks are from the future. Just to be sure. Collect a sample for carbon dating.

objectives.description: Collect Sample

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_chr.name: Sometimes They Come Back
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_chr.description: We've got new monsters! Take out Chrome Husks and collect samples for analysis.

objectives.description: Collect Chrome Husk Data

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_clo.name: Handshake
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_clo.description: Help Dennis prove the existence of time skips by collecting clock parts. Clocks are most often found in Urban and Suburban zones.

objectives.description: Collect Clocks

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_com.name: It Came From Space!
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_com.description: We should probably investigate that massive explosion. Search the zone for any signs of the meteorite.

objectives.description: Collect Meteorite Shards

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_con.name: Project Tailor
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_con.description: The cure for Spitfire’s illness may be hidden in the Vindertech archives. Help Ray track down audio logs related to Vindertech’s first armored suit prototype. Look for system terminals in Industrial zones.

objectives.description: Find Project Tailor Files

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_cow.name: I Have No Voice and I Must Moo
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_cow.description: Lok isn’t ready to lead the way, but he still deserves a voice. Collect farm sounds to give him the voice pack of his dreams.

objectives.description: Collect Farm Sounds

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_dep.name: Look Out!
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_dep.description: We can’t destroy a meteorite without lasers, and we can’t make lasers without glass, so there’s only one solution. Search for lightning glass by deploying SEE-bots in lightning rich environments.

objectives.description: Deploy SEE-bots

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_ear.name: Earthquakes!
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_ear.description: Is it just me, or have there been a lot of unexplained earthquakes since the meteorite landed? We should probably look into that. Deploy remote seismographs, and I’ll analyze the data.

objectives.description: Deploy Remote Seismographs

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_fan.name: Bee Gone
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_fan.description: Help Ray collect fans to clear the bees from Homebase. Found inside houses and buildings.

objectives.description: Collect Fans

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_fly.name: Super Flyers
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_fly.description: You can't battle a mysterious space rock without a team of super-powered superheroes! Let's let the superhero community know we're recruiting!

objectives.description: Launch Flyers

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_jul.name: Independence Day
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_jul.description: Celebrate the independence of our Home Base with a display of festive fireworks!

objectives.description: Launch Fireworks

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_mag.name: Magnets!
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_mag.description: The Cloaked Star might have a solution for the Chrome Husk infestation. Stand by to deploy magnetic snares!

objectives.description: Deploy Magnetic Snares

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_mai.name: Post Credits
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_mai.description: Replies are piling up from Lok's superhero job posting. Search mailboxes to find a true hero.

objectives.description: Search Mailboxes

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_mat.name: Sleep On It
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_mat.description: We've saved so many survivors we're running out of beds. Search the area for suitable mattresses. Beds are mostly found in Suburban and Urban zones.

objectives.description: Collect Mattresses

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_may.name: Renegade Rampage
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_may.description: It looks like there's a new vigilante in town. Follow the path of destruction and search for clues for the vigilante's identity.

objectives.description: Follow The Trail Of Destruction

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_por.name: Jack Of All Trades
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_por.description: Homebase plumbing is crisis waiting to happen. Help Jack collect everything we need to stave off disaster. Look for portable toilets in the Industrial Zones.

objectives.description: Collect Neutralizer Fluid

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_ray.name: Ray Of Hope
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_ray.description: It's time for Lok's reign of terror to come to an end. Deploy searchlights to call Ray back to Homebase.

objectives.description: Deploy Lights

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_res.name: Fallen Star
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_res.description: Whether he wants it or not, The Cloaked Star needs our help. Search the zone, we need to find him before it’s too late!

objectives.description: Rescue The Cloaked Star

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_res.name: Taste Wizard
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_res.description: The Taste Wizard predictive ordering network has been corrupted by the storm. Help Dennis destroy Taste Wizard before it destroys us all. The restaurants are most often found in Urban zones.

objectives.description: Upload Dennis’ Order

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_ret.name: Don't Blink
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_ret.description: We need glass to build our lasers. Collect SEE-bots to search for evidence of lightning glass.

objectives.description: Collect SEE-bots

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_rub.name: Ex-Ray
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_rub.description: We have the Project Tailor plans! Start collecting the materials we’ll need to build the suit as we listen to the audio logs. The high density rubber can be found in Industrial and Urban zones.

objectives.description: Collect High Density Rubber

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_sca.name: Malevolent Presence
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_sca.description: Deploy scanners to test Dennis’ theory about a rogue network coming online.

objectives.description: Deploy Scanners

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_shi.name: Ready-to-war
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_shi.description: If we understood more about Shield Husks, we’d be able to improve the shielding in Spitfire’s suit. Collect Shielder Husk data.

objectives.description: Collect Shielder Data

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_tan.name: Blocked!
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_tan.description: We almost have everything we need to complete Spitfire’s suit. Collect stainless steel as we sort through the last of the Project Tailor audio logs. This quest requires an Industrial zone.

objectives.description: Destroy Tank Trucks To Collect Steel

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_tom.name: Every Film Bed, Woof!
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_tom.description: The Cloaked Star has been… smashing gravestones. We should probably look into that.

objectives.description: Search Smashed Gravestones

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_toy.name: Baby Daddy
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_toy.description: Collect stuffed animals to prepare Dennis for the biggest journey of his life. Toys are most often found in Suburban and Urban zones.

objectives.description: Collect Stuffed Animals

quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_tro.name: Lie to Me
quest:blockbusterquest_2018_reactive_tro.description: It’s time to find out if Raven can be trusted. Search the zone for everything we need to build a lie detector. Look for a hospital, which is most likely to be found in the Urban zone.

objectives.description: Collect Testing Equipment

quest:bot_fetch_quest_a1.name: Lone Wolf-bot
quest:bot_fetch_quest_a1.description: With the rest of the Homebase Crew joining the fight, Ray faces a difficult choice.

objectives.description: Collect movies

quest:bot_fetch_quest_a2.name: No Cameras Please
quest:bot_fetch_quest_a2.description: Ray's ready to take her first step into battle, but it's not going to be pretty.

objectives.description: Deactivate surveillance cameras

quest:bot_reactivekill_quest_a3.name: Ray-Bot Rampage
quest:bot_reactivekill_quest_a3.description: Take cover! Ray-Bot is armed, dangerous, and ready for action.

objectives.description: Eliminate Husks

quest:brainstorm_quest_a01_gather.name: A Dark and Brainstormy Night
quest:brainstorm_quest_a01_gather.description: The Door to Darkness is re-opening. Willow needs your help investigating who or what's behind it!

objectives.description: Search the Haunted Hotel for clues

quest:brainstorm_quest_a02_eliminate.name: Don't Quoth Me
quest:brainstorm_quest_a02_eliminate.description: Lars leads the team into zombie chicken combat with a spooky story.

objectives.description: Eliminate Zombie Chickens in Hexsylvania.

quest:brainstorm_quest_a03_fetch.name: Well Well Well...
quest:brainstorm_quest_a03_fetch.description: After falling into a well, Dennis must come to terms with his greatest fears.

objectives.description: Search wells in Hexsylvania and eliminate Takers.

quest:brainstorm_quest_a04_deliver.name: Girlbossurtunity
quest:brainstorm_quest_a04_deliver.description: Those last stories were child’s play. Sarah’s got a REAL scary story to share.

objectives.description: Deliver boxes of loungewear to unsuspecting citizens.

quest:brainstorm_quest_a05_fetch.name: The Heat of Paddle
quest:brainstorm_quest_a05_fetch.description: Spooky stories can always be improved with a campfire! Hint: Best found in Haunted Forest or Swamp zones. Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Light 6 Campfires

quest:brainstorm_quest_a06_destroy.name: It's All Gravey
quest:brainstorm_quest_a06_destroy.description: Discover Willow's greatest fear by helping her track down and destroy some ominously named tombstones...

objectives.description: Destroy Tombstones

quest:brainstorm_quest_a07_landmark.name: Jar-Related Consequences
quest:brainstorm_quest_a07_landmark.description: Foil Brainstorm's spooky plan by battling the Door to Darkness!

objectives.description: Fight through the haunted hotel basement.

quest:brainstorm_quest_a08_fetch.name: Fill 'er Up
quest:brainstorm_quest_a08_fetch.description: Refresh Brainstorm’s brine and return him to his normal brain monster state.

objectives.description: Gather new Brain Brine from lab equipment.

quest:cannyvalley_hidden_enablegunslinge.name: (Hidden) Canny Valley Enable Dark Gunslinger Spawn Quest

objectives.description: (Hidden) Complete CannyValley_Landmark_HighNoon Quest

quest:cannyvalley_hidden_end_watchvideo.name: (Hidden) Canny Valley End Watch Video Quest

objectives.description: (Hidden) Watch Canny Valley End Video
(Hidden) Watch Canny Valley Video

quest:cannyvalley_landmark_bossfight.name: Battle Royal
quest:cannyvalley_landmark_bossfight.description: Enter the portal and deliver the ultimate bomb.

objectives.description: Enter the Portal

quest:cannyvalley_landmark_deploytheprob.name: Remote Control
quest:cannyvalley_landmark_deploytheprob.description: Test the new remote detonation device by sending a probe through a rift.

objectives.description: Deploy the probe

quest:cannyvalley_landmark_highnoon.name: Gravestone
quest:cannyvalley_landmark_highnoon.description: Explore the town of Gravestone and prepare for a high noon duel with the deadliest husk in Canny Valley.

objectives.description: Battle Legendary Gunslinger Husk in a 52+ zone, and explore Gravestone.

quest:cannyvalley_landmark_mansion.name: Have You Tried Turning It On and Off Again?
quest:cannyvalley_landmark_mansion.description: Explore Vinderman's mansion and unpack the Vinderman AI from the SEE-Bot to the Mansion's mainframe.

objectives.description: Activate the Vinderman AI

quest:cannyvalley_landmark_memorial.name: V
quest:cannyvalley_landmark_memorial.description: It's time for Ray to say goodbye to an old Friend. Help Penny build a memorial for Dr. Vinderman.

objectives.description: Build a Memorial in a 46+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_landmark_rift.name: Through the Rift
quest:cannyvalley_landmark_rift.description: Bring Carlos back from the other side. Stabilize the Rift!

objectives.description: Complete the Stabilize the Rift mission in a 64+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_landmark_welcome.name: Please Hold
quest:cannyvalley_landmark_welcome.description: Canny Valley, here we come! Get ready to explore the world beyond Plankerton. Can be only completed in Thunder Route 99.

objectives.description: Discover Landmark in a 46+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_mechanical_constructor.name: Just Build
quest:cannyvalley_mechanical_constructor.description: With all the sharp-shooting husks in Canny Valley, it's time to brush up on combat building. Build 100 structures in a successful mission.

objectives.description: Build Structures in a 52+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_mechanical_exploration.name: Blue Skies
quest:cannyvalley_mechanical_exploration.description: Find out what happened here. Explore a ghost town zone.

objectives.description: Fully explore a Ghost Town zone in a successful mission

quest:cannyvalley_mechanical_killriotshi.name: Fridge Logic
quest:cannyvalley_mechanical_killriotshi.description: These Huskies are causing a riot! See what you can do about them!

objectives.description: Eliminate Riot Shield Huskies in a 70+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_mechanical_shelterresc.name: Evacuate Immediately!
quest:cannyvalley_mechanical_shelterresc.description: Earthquake's coming! Evacuate the Shelters in the earthquake zone.

objectives.description: Complete an Evacuate the Shelter mission in a 64+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_aftercredits.name: How I Wonder What You Are
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_aftercredits.description: Take a look back, and a look at things to come.

objectives.description: Deploy telescopes in a 70+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_bases.name: Canny Underground
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_bases.description: Search the borders of arid zones for underground bunkers. Can be only completed in a desert or Thunder Route 99 zone.

objectives.description: Search Bunkers in a 52+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_bikes.name: A Bonding Experience
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_bikes.description: Get ready for one last ride...

objectives.description: Collect motorcycles in a 70+ Thunder Route 99 zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_cannons.name: Cannon Fodder
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_cannons.description: Help Dennis rock out to shake off the Homebase funk.

objectives.description: Collect cannons in a 70+ Ghost Town zone
Inspect SEA-Bots in a 70+ Ghost Town zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_cards.name: El Jefe
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_cards.description: Help Carlos and Lars settle the score with a winner take all game of Jefe.

objectives.description: Gather cards in a 64+ Ghost Town zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_clocks.name: When There's a Will...
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_clocks.description: Help Ray collect clock parts for a LAW-Bot.

objectives.description: Collect clock parts in a 70+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_coaches.name: Seventeen
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_coaches.description: Collect stagecoaches to build a SEE-Bot search caravan.

objectives.description: Search for coaches in a 58+ Ghost Town zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_demotape.name: Stand and Fight
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_demotape.description: Steel Wool has reunited! Search the zone for their latest single.

objectives.description: Find Steel Wool's new demo tape in a 70+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_dinobones.name: The Bones Collector
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_dinobones.description: Help Dennis collect bones for his latest experiment. Can be only completed in a desert or Thunder Route 99 zone.

objectives.description: Collect Bones in a 46+ zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_dinosaurs.name: Smashasaurus
quest:cannyvalley_reactive_dinosaurs.description: Help Dennis express himself with a little dinosaur smashing.

objectives.description: Smash Dinosaurs in a 70+ Ghost Town zone

quest:cannyvalley_reactive_dredgers.name: Fool and His Gold

Select Research: Tier 1
Select the Fortitude Research node
Select Purchase to unlock the node
