Gather 5 pieces of Taker data in a 15+ zone

quest:reactivequest_transmitters.name: Signal Boost
quest:reactivequest_transmitters.description: We need to boost our transmission strength, search for locators we can use. May require multiple missions.

objectives.description: Deploy 3 locators (often found in City zones) in a 15+ zone

quest:reactivequest_trollstash_r1.name: Troll Key
quest:reactivequest_trollstash_r1.description: Whack a Trolls sometimes drop special keys that will open the Epic loot stash chest. Find the key, and then we'll start a treasure hunt!

objectives.description: Find the Troll Key in a 15+ zone

quest:reactivequest_trollstash_r2.name: Epic Troll Stash
quest:reactivequest_trollstash_r2.description: Find the Epic Troll Stash. Trolls like to hide in caves, so that's a good place to start looking.

objectives.description: Find the Troll Loot Stash in a 15+ zone

quest:reactivequest_waterhusks.name: Lok's Monster: Water
quest:reactivequest_waterhusks.description: Collect Water Husk samples for Lok.

objectives.description: Gather 10 pieces of Water monster data in a 40+ zone

quest:s10_explore_quest_a5.name: Ray Array
quest:s10_explore_quest_a5.description: Explore parks where versions of Ray may have returned from the future in suburban and urban zones.

objectives.description: Search parks in suburban and urban zones

quest:s10_explore_quest_a8.name: Sending the Suit
quest:s10_explore_quest_a8.description: Explore potential hiding locations for Dennis Jr.

objectives.description: Explore a restaurant
Explore a construction site
Explore a park

quest:s10_fetch_quest_a10.name: Dark Days
quest:s10_fetch_quest_a10.description: Help set up a tribunal for Dark Ray by collecting judge wigs.

objectives.description: Collect judge wigs

quest:s10_fetch_quest_a11.name: This Time
quest:s10_fetch_quest_a11.description: Deploy boomboxes to broadcast Dennis Jr.'s messages from the future.

objectives.description: Deploy Boombox

quest:s10_fetch_quest_a12.name: The Big Slurp
quest:s10_fetch_quest_a12.description: Deploy sensor balloons to help Lars determine if reality is collapsing.

objectives.description: Deploy Sensor Balloon

quest:s10_fetch_quest_a15.name: The Forever Ned
quest:s10_fetch_quest_a15.description: It's not a time stabilization suit, but the next best thing: deploy Ned Packs while looking for other ways of helping Ned.

objectives.description: Deploy Ned Packs

quest:s10_fetch_quest_a3.name: And Dennis Jr. Makes Three
quest:s10_fetch_quest_a3.description: Search for DNA testing equipment for Dennis Jr. Hint: Best found in urban, suburban, or industrial zones.

objectives.description: Find DNA blood testing equipment

quest:s10_fetch_quest_a4.name: Tell Me Everything
quest:s10_fetch_quest_a4.description: Find boxes of hypnosis equipment to help jog Dennis Jr.'s memory.

objectives.description: Find boxes of hypnosis materials

quest:s10_fetch_quest_b1.name: You Broke Time
quest:s10_fetch_quest_b1.description: You broke time! Search the zone for Vindertech Holo-Kiosks to see if we can undo the damage. Note: the holo kiosks might look different depending on the timeline you are currently inhabiting.

objectives.description: Find Holo-kiosks

quest:s10_fetch_quest_b2.name: Coalition of Doomed and Failed Realities
quest:s10_fetch_quest_b2.description: Search the zone for non-apocalyptic solutions to repair our broken timeline.

objectives.description: Collect Books

quest:s10_gathercollect_quest_a14.name: Long Road Home
quest:s10_gathercollect_quest_a14.description: Destroy cabinets and collect canned supplies to prepare Dennis Jr. for his return to his own reality.

objectives.description: Destroy cabinets and collect cans of food

quest:s10_gathercollect_quest_a2.name: I Collect Coins
quest:s10_gathercollect_quest_a2.description: Destroy coin operated machines and collect coins to test Lars' theory of colliding realities. Hint: Best found in urban, suburban, or industrial zones.

objectives.description: Destroy coin operated machines and collect the coins dropped

quest:s10_gathercollect_quest_a6.name: It's a Lot to Give
quest:s10_gathercollect_quest_a6.description: Help Ned escape his time loop by destroying fire trucks, police cars, and ambulances to collect nedkits.

objectives.description: Destroy fire trucks, police cars, and ambulances to collect nedkits

quest:s10_gathercollect_quest_a9.name: Deadbeat
quest:s10_gathercollect_quest_a9.description: Destroy book cases and collect "Psychology for Dummies" books in suburban or urban zones.

objectives.description: Destroy bookcases to collect books

quest:s10_kill_quest_b3.name: Vroo-Over
quest:s10_kill_quest_b3.description: Fight the husky horde and keep an ear out for Ray's Time Broadcasts.

objectives.description: Eliminate Husky Husks

quest:s10_killcollect_questa7.name: Timeless Fashion
quest:s10_killcollect_questa7.description: Dennis Jr. needs materials to build a stabilization suit. Eliminate Husky Husks or Smashers to collect the needed Dense Violentium.

objectives.description: Eliminate Husky Husks or Smashers and gather Dense Violentium

quest:s10_landmark_quest_a1.name: Comet Jr.
quest:s10_landmark_quest_a1.description: Gather intel at the site of the meteor impact.

objectives.description: Investigate the meteor

quest:s10_reactivekill_quest_a13.name: Darkerest Days
quest:s10_reactivekill_quest_a13.description: Eliminate Mist Monsters to avoid a Dark Future.

objectives.description: Eliminate Mist Monsters

quest:s11_custom_quest_f0.name: Bonus: Protector of Presents
quest:s11_custom_quest_f0.description: The husks have started a war on presents! Protect as many presents as possible and give everyone a happy holiday. Hint: Must be completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Collect presents in a Protect the Presents mission

quest:s11_destroy_quest_c1.name: Axes Of Evil
quest:s11_destroy_quest_c1.description: Help survive the week at camp by destroying Slasher axes. Must be completed in Shady Acres.

objectives.description: Destroy slasher's axes in Shady Acres

quest:s11_destroy_quest_d4.name: What Mobs Do
quest:s11_destroy_quest_d4.description: The villagers are agitated by Arrlene and may be assembling a mob. Destroy their boats to slow them down. Hint: Best found in Hexsylvanian swamps. Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Destroy boats in Hexsylvania

quest:s11_destroy_quest_e3.name: Night 3: Leave This Place
quest:s11_destroy_quest_e3.description: Legends about the hotel indicate that scary statues in the garden labyrinth may be the source of the hauntings. Investigate... or interrogate the statues. Must be completed during a Survive the Night mission.

objectives.description: Destroy scary statues in the garden labyrinth

quest:s11_destroy_quest_e6.name: Night 6: Nice Ghost
quest:s11_destroy_quest_e6.description: Willow insists that the evil gnomes throughout the hotel be destroyed for everyone's safety. Must be completed during a Survive the Night mission.

objectives.description: Destroy evil gnomes in the hotel

quest:s11_destroy_quest_f0.name: Bonus: Cracking Down
quest:s11_destroy_quest_f0.description: Find and destroy Crackshot's favorite decoration in Crackshot's Neighborhood. Hint: Must be completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Destroy Crackshot's favorite decoration

quest:s11_destroy_quest_h2.name: The Rise of Jilly
quest:s11_destroy_quest_h2.description: Jilly is tired of the other toys stealing her spotlight. Destroy as many as you can find!  Hint: Best completed in City or Suburban zones.

objectives.description: Destroy toys

quest:s11_fetch_quest_b1.name: Where Wolf?
quest:s11_fetch_quest_b1.description: Mysterious trees in Hexsylvania need to be investigated. Could they be signs of a Werewolf? Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Search for clawed trees in Hexsylvania

quest:s11_fetch_quest_b2.name: Blood Moon Rising
quest:s11_fetch_quest_b2.description: Set up telescopes to observe and determine the exact moment of the Super Blood moon. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Deploy telescopes in Hexsylvania

quest:s11_fetch_quest_b4.name: Neighborhood Night Watch
quest:s11_fetch_quest_b4.description: Interview sleeping vampires resting in their coffins to learn more about werewolves in Hexsylvania. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Give flasks to sleeping vampires in coffins

quest:s11_fetch_quest_b5.name: The Dire
quest:s11_fetch_quest_b5.description: Help Dire through the Packstravaganza and get more info on the wolfpack's plans. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Deploy receivers in Hexsylvania

quest:s11_fetch_quest_b7.name: Get Packing
quest:s11_fetch_quest_b7.description: Deploy wolfsbane amulets in Hexsylvania and restore peace to the land... for now. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Deploy wolfsbane amulets

quest:s11_fetch_quest_c2.name: Notes From On The Ground
quest:s11_fetch_quest_c2.description: Raven is ready to help translate old journal clippings from Slashers you can find in the wilderness. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Find journal clippings from Slashers

quest:s11_fetch_quest_c4.name: Lurk Free Zone
quest:s11_fetch_quest_c4.description: Gather backpacks and prepare for the No Lurking Challenge. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Find backpacks for hiking

quest:s11_fetch_quest_c5.name: Dry Docked
quest:s11_fetch_quest_c5.description: Gather paddles for slashers only canoe race. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Find paddles for canoes

quest:s11_fetch_quest_c6.name: Bury the Hatchet
quest:s11_fetch_quest_c6.description: Grab some targets for hatchet throwing practice and attempt to make peace with the Slashers. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Find targets for practice

quest:s11_fetch_quest_d2.name: Are We Calling it a Monster?
quest:s11_fetch_quest_d2.description: Lightning rods are needed for the next step of Penny's plan. Deploy lightning rods in the area. Needs to be completed in Hexsylvania.  Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Deploy lightning rods in Hexsylvania

quest:s11_fetch_quest_d3.name: Dear Di-arrrr-y
quest:s11_fetch_quest_d3.description: Find and read the diary entries to learn more about Arrlene. Must be completed in Hexsylvania. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Find Arrlene's diary entries

quest:s11_fetch_quest_d7.name: Dearly Departed
quest:s11_fetch_quest_d7.description: Construct a luxury honeymoon RV wagon by salvaging old wagons in Hexsylvania. Hint: Best found in swamps. Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Gather caravan wagons in Hexsylvania

quest:s11_fetch_quest_e2.name: Night 2: Ghost Boss
quest:s11_fetch_quest_e2.description: Investigate clues to learn more about the hauntings in the hotel. Must be completed during a Survive the Night mission.

objectives.description: Investigate clues in the hotel

quest:s11_fetch_quest_e5.name: Night 5: Debnis
quest:s11_fetch_quest_e5.description: It is time to communicate with the "ghost." Set up spirit boards to talk with Lok's imaginary friend. Must be completed during a Survive the Night mission.

objectives.description: Deploy spirit boards throughout the hotel

quest:s11_fetch_quest_e7.name: Day 7: Dear Ghost Diary
quest:s11_fetch_quest_e7.description: Gather pages in the hotel which were torn from Willow's diary and discover how to help. Must be completed during a Survive the Night mission.

objectives.description: Collect Willow's diary entries

quest:s11_fetch_quest_f3.name: The Holiday's Hottest Toy
quest:s11_fetch_quest_f3.description: Crackshot demands the holiday season's hottest toy. Find it, or else! Hint: Best completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Find presents for Crackshot

quest:s11_fetch_quest_f5.name: Stockings Must Hang
quest:s11_fetch_quest_f5.description: Spread holiday cheer by decorating trees in Crackshot's Neighborhood. Hint: Best completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Decorate trees for the holidays

quest:s11_fetch_quest_f7.name: A Hopeful Song
quest:s11_fetch_quest_f7.description: Celebrate the holidays by blaring music from speakers for all to hear, whether they like it or not. Hint: Best completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Deploy speakers to spread holiday cheer

quest:s11_fetch_quest_fgift.name: Bonus: Crackshot's Treasure
quest:s11_fetch_quest_fgift.description: Use the mysterious key to unlock Crackshot's secret holiday treasure - a gift to you! Hint: Must be completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Use the key to unlock Crackshot's hidden treasure

quest:s11_fetch_quest_fkey.name: Bonus: Crackshot's Key
quest:s11_fetch_quest_fkey.description: Crackshot has lost the key to his holiday treasure. Hint: Must be completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Find Crackshot's lost key

quest:s11_fetch_quest_g1.name: No Sleep 'Til...
quest:s11_fetch_quest_g1.description: Homebase is having trouble sleeping, so it's time to make the best of the situation. Collect coffee makers to help keep the team awake. Hint: Best completed in a City or Suburban zone.

objectives.description: Collect coffee makers

quest:s11_fetch_quest_g3.name: All I Want For Christmas is Boo
quest:s11_fetch_quest_g3.description: Dennis wants to make Willow a delicious ghost meal, but needs some help to find what ghosts eat. Hint: Best completed in a City or Suburban zone.

objectives.description: Search book piles for ghost cookbooks

quest:s11_fetch_quest_g7.name: There's No Place Like Van for the Holidays
quest:s11_fetch_quest_g7.description: Join Lars and Willow to deliver gifts to the survivors and spread hope and joy to everyone!

objectives.description: Deliver gifts to survivors

quest:s11_fetch_quest_h3.name: The Bean Plan
quest:s11_fetch_quest_h3.description: Ray has been deposed and exiled from Homebase. She has a plan and she needs beans to pull it off.

objectives.description: Collect cans of beans

quest:s11_fetch_quest_h6.name: Tea And Sympathy
quest:s11_fetch_quest_h6.description: Ray is going to help Jilly make amends and there's no better way than breaking bread with those she has wronged, or - in this case - sharing tea.

objectives.description: Set up apology tea parties

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_b3.name: Wakey Wakey
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_b3.description: Maybe vampires can help us solve our were-problems. Gather flasks from cabinets in Hexsylvania. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Destroy cabinets to collect flasks

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_b6.name: Wolf Me, Wolf Me Not
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_b6.description: Gather the wolfsbane plant leaves to deter the wolfpack. Hint: Best found in swamps. Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Destroy and collect wolfsbane plant leaves

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_c3.name: What's a landline?
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_c3.description: A big camp fire is a great place for spooky stories. Destroy campfires to gather marshmallow sticks. Best completed in Shady Acres.

objectives.description: Destroy campfires to gather marshmallow sticks

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_d1.name: Find Your Backbone
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_d1.description: Penny needs bags of... things. Gather bags from lab furniture because she pretty much needs it all. Needs to be completed in Hexsylvania.  Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Destroy lab furniture to collect bags of things

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_d5.name: Save The Date
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_d5.description: Water plants are a vital component to summon monsters. Harvest water plants in the swamps for the Summoning Soup. Hint: Best found in Hexsylvanian swamps. Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Destroy water plants to collect its flower

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_e4.name: Night 4: Hissing Contest
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_e4.description: The ghosts haunting the hotel are restless. Investigating where they took their final rest will lead to answers. Gather ghost ectoplasm samples from hotel beds. Must be completed during a Survive the Night mission.

objectives.description: Gather ghost ectoplasm samples from hotel beds

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_f0.name: Bonus: Needle in a Haystack
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_f0.description: Finding a needle in a haystack may not be as difficult as everyone says it is. Hint: Must be completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Find the needle

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_f4.name: Bring Me Santa's Head
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_f4.description: Crackshot has demanded Santa's head. Ray has a different idea. Collect newspapers to create paper-mache. Hint: Best completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Gather papers from newsstands

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_f6.name: His Heart Grew Five Sizes
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_f6.description: It is time for Crackshot to learn his valuable lesson. Collect expired energy drinks to help him become a large-hearted holiday hero. Hint: Best completed in a Protect the Presents mission.

objectives.description: Destroy vending machines to gather energy drinks

quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_g2.name: O Ghostmas Tree
quest:s11_gathercollect_quest_g2.description: To help Willow feel like she's not alone, Ray has decided to create ghost trees. Destroy beds to collect bedsheets. Hint: Best completed in a City or Suburban zone.

objectives.description: Gather bedsheets by destroying beds

quest:s11_holdfastquest_d1_burner.name: BluGlo Burner
quest:s11_holdfastquest_d1_burner.description: When it’s this cold, it’s hard to stay warm! Make sure you’re doing your part to put BluGlo into the Furnace!

objectives.description: Deposit 15 BluGlo into the Furnace in a single Frostnite mission

quest:s11_holdfastquest_d1_construct.name: SnoFort Architect
quest:s11_holdfastquest_d1_construct.description: So you think you got what it takes to build a Frostnite Fort? Not only does it take planning, but speed and precision! You’re under pressure out there, show me you can do it! Place those structures!

objectives.description: Place 100 Structures in Frostnite

quest:s11_holdfastquest_d1_cramp.name: Krampus Krazies
quest:s11_holdfastquest_d1_cramp.description: Look at all these Krampi! - Or are they Krampuses? Maybe Krampen? - They’re a threat to everything we stand for! Make sure they’re all cleared out!

objectives.description: Eliminate all Lone Krampus targets in a single Frostnite Mission

quest:s11_holdfastquest_d1_ice.name: Icebreaker
quest:s11_holdfastquest_d1_ice.description: Come now! Don’t be shy! Let’s 'Break the Ice' and get to know each other better while we’re together, eh? Break the BluGlo out of those ice blocks so we can keep this fire warm.

objectives.description: Break out BluGlo from Ice Blocks in Frostnite 7 times.

quest:s11_holdfastquest_d2_constructor.name: Frosty Builder
quest:s11_holdfastquest_d2_constructor.description: Brrr! It’s cold! But that shouldn’t hold you back! You’re frosty for sure! How long can you last out there as a Constructor?

objectives.description: Survive for 30 Minutes in a single mission of Frostnite as a Constructor

quest:s11_holdfastquest_d2_ninja.name: Frosty Shinobi
quest:s11_holdfastquest_d2_ninja.description: Brrr! It’s cold! But that shouldn’t hold you back! You’re frosty for sure! How long can you last out there as a Ninja?

objectives.description: Survive for 30 Minutes in a single mission of Frostnite as a Ninja

quest:s11_holdfastquest_d2_outlander.name: Frosty Looter
quest:s11_holdfastquest_d2_outlander.description: Brrr! It’s cold! But that shouldn’t hold you back! You’re frosty for sure! How long can you last out there as an Outlander?

objectives.description: Survive for 30 Minutes in a single mission of Frostnite as an Outlander

quest:s11_holdfastquest_d2_soldier.name: Frosty Warrior
quest:s11_holdfastquest_d2_soldier.description: Brrr! It’s cold! But that shouldn’t hold you back! You’re frosty for sure! How long can you last out there as a Soldier?

objectives.description: Survive for 30 Minutes in a single mission of Frostnite as a Soldier

quest:s11_holdfastquest_deliver_30.name: Gopher
quest:s11_holdfastquest_deliver_30.description: Gopher! Deliver the BluGlo! Chop Chop! Those dispensers have to make it at least past 30 minutes or my - I mean, Our - supply will dip! Get going!

objectives.description: Survive for 30 minutes in a single mission of Special Delivery

quest:s11_holdfastquest_deliver_45.name: Mailman
quest:s11_holdfastquest_deliver_45.description: Mail Call! Mail Call! I need this BluGlo delivered to your burner! Stay out there for at least 45 minutes while I redraw supply routes and other jargon-y stuff!

objectives.description: Survive for 45 minutes in a single mission of Special Delivery

quest:s11_holdfastquest_deliver_bluglo.name: Keep your hands off my BluGlo!
quest:s11_holdfastquest_deliver_bluglo.description: They’re after My- ah- Our BluGlo! Don’t let them take it! If they break the dispensers I’ll never have control over the BluGlo! They who control the BluGlo controls the Universe!

objectives.description: Complete Wave 11 with all BluGlo dispensers intact.

quest:s11_holdfastquest_deliver_elite.name: Through Sleet and Snow
quest:s11_holdfastquest_deliver_elite.description: This supply line can’t be broken! You gotta make those BluGlo deliveries throughout the night. I’ll make it worth your while! Just don’t let them take my- I mean- our BluGlo!

objectives.description: Complete Wave 20 in Special Delivery

quest:s11_holdfastquest_frosty_30.name: A Crunch of Snow
quest:s11_holdfastquest_frosty_30.description: Just listen to the quiet fall of snow; crunchy, isn't it? Makes you wanna go out and frolic among the husks, taking a swing at them every now and then, spring a few traps, you know, the usual! See you in 30?

objectives.description: Survive for 30 minutes in a single mission of Frosty Turf

quest:s11_holdfastquest_frosty_45.name: Trapper's Delight
quest:s11_holdfastquest_frosty_45.description: Yeah the traps are freezing, and yeah the night is cold. But don’t let that stop you! Survive at least 45 minutes out there and I’ll make it worth your while!

objectives.description: Survive for 45 minutes in a single mission of Frosty Turf

quest:s11_holdfastquest_frosty_elite.name: Breaking the Permafrost
quest:s11_holdfastquest_frosty_elite.description: Ok, so the traps are freezing up, it’s cold outside, and the enemy have us surrounded. Perfect! They have nowhere to run to now!

objectives.description: Complete Wave 20 in Frosty Turf

quest:s11_holdfastquest_frosty_traps.name: Frosty the Trapper
quest:s11_holdfastquest_frosty_traps.description: What’s that? The traps are freezing up? It’s only -60C outside! They’ll work fine, and I’ll prove it to you! Go eliminate 100 Husks with those traps!

objectives.description: Eliminate 100 husks with traps in Frosty Turf

quest:s11_holdfastquest_legend_15.name: Reaching for Greatness
quest:s11_holdfastquest_legend_15.description: You only get so many shots, so go. Each time, higher and higher as you chase that status. This is but a stepping stone.

objectives.description: Complete Wave 15 in Final Frost

quest:s11_holdfastquest_legend_30.name: The First Step
quest:s11_holdfastquest_legend_30.description: They say a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. That’s how Legends are forged. This is your first step. Last for 30 minutes.

objectives.description: Survive for 30 minutes in a single mission of Final Frost

quest:s11_holdfastquest_legend_45.name: A Tale to Tell
quest:s11_holdfastquest_legend_45.description: Folk tales and heroes are hardly the stuff of Legend. But they have the potential to be. Write me a tale to tell, if you can. 45 minutes is all it takes, now go.

objectives.description: Survive for 45 minutes in a single mission of Final Frost

quest:s11_holdfastquest_legend_elite.name: The Legends of the Frost
quest:s11_holdfastquest_legend_elite.description: The longest and darkest night is here. It is the Final Frost. But remember as they say; It is darkest before the dawn. Survive the Final Frost, so we may raise our mugs to you, once you become Legends.

objectives.description: Complete Wave 20 in Final Frost

quest:s11_holdfastquest_merry_30.name: Merry Mangler
quest:s11_holdfastquest_merry_30.description: Got your melee weapon? Good, you’re gonna need it. The husks are everywhere, and the cold has jammed all the guns. It’ll be tough, but I know you can make it at least 30 minutes out there!

objectives.description: Survive for 30 minutes in a single mission of Merry Melee

quest:s11_holdfastquest_merry_45.name: Merry Mauler
quest:s11_holdfastquest_merry_45.description: You made it to 30 minutes? Great! The temperature keeps dropping, so we’re still a no-go on the guns front. Think you can make it to 45 minutes?

objectives.description: Survive for 45 minutes in a single mission of Merry Melee

quest:s11_holdfastquest_merry_craft.name: Merry Forger
quest:s11_holdfastquest_merry_craft.description: The greatest of weapons are forged in the fires of battle, for it is those that aid you the most! Do yourself a favor, and get one! I guarantee it’ll extend your survivability out there!

objectives.description: Craft an epic or better melee weapon in Merry Melee

quest:s11_holdfastquest_merry_elite.name: Merry Madness
quest:s11_holdfastquest_merry_elite.description: How do you feel about dancing? Dancing among a horde of husks with a trusty melee weapon! Make it through the night and there’s a nice prize waiting for you at the end!

objectives.description: Complete Wave 20 in Merry Melee

quest:s11_holdfastquest_repeat_ice.name: Ice Picker
quest:s11_holdfastquest_repeat_ice.description: Don’t be picky! Well, actually, yes. Be picky, pick that ice! Get the BluGlo out of those Ice Blocks so we can use them!

objectives.description: Break out BluGlo from Ice Blocks in Frostnite 3 times in a single mission (Note: This is a repeatable quest)

quest:s11_holdfastquest_repeat_pathfinde.name: Winter Pathfinder
quest:s11_holdfastquest_repeat_pathfinde.description: It’s cold, dark, and we have no knowledge of what’s around us. We need a survey of the area so we have a better shot at success.

objectives.description: Explore the entire map in a single mission of Frostnite

quest:s11_holdfastquest_repeat_taste.name: A Taste of the Cold
quest:s11_holdfastquest_repeat_taste.description: It’s mighty cold outside! It might not be for everyone, but go ahead and spend some time to get used to things. You don’t have to shoot for the moon or anything, just… try it out. It’s ok if you fail, you just gotta get back up and try again!

objectives.description: Survive a total of 30 waves in Frostnite (Note: This is a repeatable quest)

quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_burner.name: Burner Fuel
quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_burner.description: Keep that burner topped off with BluGlo! (Only available in Frostnite)

objectives.description: Deposit 200 BluGlo into the Burner in Frostnite

quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_furnacema.name: Furnace Aflame
quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_furnacema.description: The furnace is what’s keeping the storm at bay and baking my cookies! Make sure you keep it lit, otherwise we’re all in trouble!

objectives.description: Keep the BluGlo Furnace above 50% for more than 10 Waves

quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_loot.name: Cold Hard Cache
quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_loot.description: Restock our supplies by looting as many hidden chests or safes as you can! (Only available in Frostnite)

objectives.description: Loot 40 Chests (or safes) in Frostnite

quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_misty.name: Mist of the North
quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_misty.description: Eliminate as many Mist Monsters as you can. (Only available in Frostnite)

objectives.description: Eliminate 50 Mist Monsters in Frostnite

quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_survive_1.name: Survival Basics
quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_survive_1.description: The night is upon us! Do whatever it takes to survive 15 minutes in Frostnite!

objectives.description: Survive for 15 minutes in a single Frostnite Mission

quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_survive_3.name: Winter Survival
quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_survive_3.description: The night is upon us! Do whatever it takes to survive 30 minutes in Frostnite!

objectives.description: Survive for 30 minutes in a single Frostnite Mission

quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_survive_4.name: Polar Survival
quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_survive_4.description: The night is upon us! Do whatever it takes to survive 45 minutes in Frostnite!

objectives.description: Survive for 45 minutes in a single Frostnite Mission

quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_trapcraft.name: Cold Traps
quest:s11_holdfastquest_season_trapcraft.description: Craft 50 traps of Rare or higher rarity (Only available in Frostnite)

objectives.description: Craft 50 Rare (or higher) Traps in Frostnite

quest:s11_holdfastquest_seasonelite_cram.name: Master of the Krampus Hunt
quest:s11_holdfastquest_seasonelite_cram.description: They’re out there! The Krampuses! - Or is it Krampi? - And not just tonight! They’re all the way into next week! Or last week! Maybe even now! I can’t take it! They gotta be dealt with! To the last hair!

objectives.description: Complete Krampus Krazies
Eliminate 100 Lone Krampus enemies

quest:s11_holdfastquest_seasonelite_grou.name: United We Stay Warm
quest:s11_holdfastquest_seasonelite_grou.description: In the season of giving, it’s time to give with friends. Make it through the whole Frostnite in a group of one of each class. This will take the best laid plans with the closest of coordination.

objectives.description: Complete Wave 20 of Frostnite in a group with one of each class.

quest:s11_holdfastquest_seasonelite_knig.name: Frost Knight
quest:s11_holdfastquest_seasonelite_knig.description: Finish all of the waves of Frostnite in the most difficult zone! (Non-challenge missions only)

objectives.description: Complete Wave 20 of Frostnite in a 128+ Power zone

quest:s11_holdfastquest_soup_30.name: Taste the Stew
quest:s11_holdfastquest_soup_30.description: You gotta get a taste of it. Stay out there for 30 minutes, and you’ll get something packed with flavor.

objectives.description: Survive for 30 minutes in a single mission of Top it Off

quest:s11_holdfastquest_soup_45.name: Grab a Serving
quest:s11_holdfastquest_soup_45.description: Tasty, wasn’t it? There’s always more. Grab a serving, and go share it with some Husks, eh? If you can let it cook for 45 minutes, I can guarantee you a good meal.

objectives.description: Survive for 45 minutes in a single mission of Top it Off

quest:s11_holdfastquest_soup_deposit.name: Perpetual Stew
quest:s11_holdfastquest_soup_deposit.description: You ever had perpetual stew? The flavor always changes, but technically it’s the same stew, and it never stops cooking. You can’t let it empty out, and you gotta add something new every now and then. Try it with your Furnace, I bet the results will be tasty.

objectives.description: Deposit at least one BluGlo every wave for 10 waves in a single mission of Top it Off

quest:s11_holdfastquest_soup_elite.name: The Pot is Half Full
quest:s11_holdfastquest_soup_elite.description: A long night, and an even longer line. Look at all those husks out there. Do you like Gumbo? Maybe some Tomato Bisque? Those don’t take long to cook, not like what I’m cooking up now. Survive all night and you might get a treat.

objectives.description: Complete Wave 20 in Top it Off

quest:s11_holdfastquest_superhot_30.name: Dimming Embers
quest:s11_holdfastquest_superhot_30.description: The cold’s almost oppressive. Makin’ the embers dim. Tell ya what, I’m gonna put it on full blast. You should be able to make at least 30 minutes with the heat on your back.

objectives.description: Survive for 30 minutes in a single mission of Superheated

quest:s11_holdfastquest_superhot_45.name: Warming Your Hands
quest:s11_holdfastquest_superhot_45.description: I got the furnace a-blazin. That oughtta keep out the cold. But them darn Husks want the heat too, I bet. They just keep coming. Think you can run on for 45 minutes this time?

objectives.description: Survive for 45 minutes in a single mission of Superheated

quest:s11_holdfastquest_superhot_build.name: Toasty Halls and Warmer Walls
quest:s11_holdfastquest_superhot_build.description: Cold, innit? So stick close to the furnace and get warm. If you build some walls and a roof; it keeps the heat in. Why don’t you do just that? Staying warm sounds mighty nice.

objectives.description: Place 100 Structures in Superheated

quest:s11_holdfastquest_superhot_elite.name: Furnace Fires
quest:s11_holdfastquest_superhot_elite.description: Ever hear ‘A Ring Of Fire’? Cuz we got one o’ those now. If you can keep ‘er blazin through the night, we’ll be set for a good ol’ while.

objectives.description: Complete Wave 20 in Superheated

quest:s11_holdfastquest_waves_30.name: Wave Crasher
quest:s11_holdfastquest_waves_30.description: Riding the waves takes practice. You gotta start small, kiddo! You’re gonna crash into them a lot at the start, and that’s ok! Start small, and try surviving for 8 waves out there, ok?

objectives.description: Survive for 8 waves in a single mission of New Wave Holiday

quest:s11_holdfastquest_waves_45.name: Wave Diver
quest:s11_holdfastquest_waves_45.description: Congrats on making it past 8 waves kiddo! It’s time to dive in deep. Can you make it past 12 waves this time?

objectives.description: Survive for 12 waves in a single mission of New Wave Holiday

quest:s11_holdfastquest_waves_elite.name: Wave Rider
quest:s11_holdfastquest_waves_elite.description: Think you’re ready to ride the waves? It’s a long night, but I believe in you, kiddo! See you on the farside when you make it through the night!

objectives.description: Complete Wave 20 in New Wave Holiday

quest:s11_holdfastquest_waves_target.name: Making Waves
quest:s11_holdfastquest_waves_target.description: Welcome to the New Wave Holiday kiddo! There’s tons of husks out there to use as target practice, take out at least 50 of them with each kind of weapon you have! Go out there and make waves, kid!

objectives.description: Eliminate 50 Target Husks with Melee Weapons in the New Wave Holiday
Eliminate 50 Target Husks with Shotgun Weapons in the New Wave Holiday
Eliminate 50 Target Husks with Assault Rifle Weapons in the New Wave Holiday
Eliminate 50 Target Husks with Pistol Weapons in the New Wave Holiday
Eliminate 50 Target Husks with Sniper Rifle Weapons in the New Wave Holiday

quest:s11_intro_quest.name: We're Back!
quest:s11_intro_quest.description: Thank you for your patience. Complete Homebase Storm Shield Defense 1 to collect your reward!

objectives.description: Complete Homebase Storm Shield Defense 1

quest:s11_killcollect_quest_d6.name: PitchTorch
quest:s11_killcollect_quest_d6.description: Save Arrlene from the husk mob. Take their torches away from them. Must be completed in Hexsylvania. Hint: Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Eliminate torch-thrower pitchers and gather their torches

quest:s11_killcollect_quest_g5.name: Mist-letoe
quest:s11_killcollect_quest_g5.description: There's another holiday tradition that Homebase would like to try to break Willow out of her funk - mistletoe! The standard variety won't work for ghosts. Eliminate husks to find ghost mistletoe. Hint: Not all husks drop ghost mistletoe.

objectives.description: Eliminate husks to find ghost mistletoe

quest:s11_killcollect_quest_h5.name: I Am the Law... Apparently
quest:s11_killcollect_quest_h5.description: Sgt. Tank Gatling demands a trial by combat by eliminating Zappers in the area. Eliminate them and collect dense violentium to prove your case.

objectives.description: Eliminate Zapper husks and gather dense violentium

quest:s11_landmark_quest_e1.name: Night 1: Rumors of Ghost Activity
quest:s11_landmark_quest_e1.description: Explore the haunted hotel and deploy sensors to measure the supernatural field.

objectives.description: Investigate the haunted hotel

quest:s11_landmark_quest_e8.name: The Door To Darkness
quest:s11_landmark_quest_e8.description: Discover the underground crypt and deploy the ghost vacuum to stop the true threat in the hotel - the door to darkness!

objectives.description: Deploy and defend the ghost vacuum

quest:s11_landmark_quest_f1.name: Holly Jolly Ransom
quest:s11_landmark_quest_f1.description: Crackshot has been kidnapped! Collect pieces of the ransom note and discover the kidnappers' demands.

objectives.description: Investigate Crackshot's kidnapping

quest:s11_landmark_quest_g6.name: We Wish You a Merry Fright Maze
quest:s11_landmark_quest_g6.description: The best gifts are personal. For Willow, that's a giant maze she can haunt.

objectives.description: Build a maze for Willow to haunt in Crackshot's Neighborhood

quest:s11_landmark_quest_h4.name: Toying With Your Emotions
quest:s11_landmark_quest_h4.description: Ted has been sentenced to die! There must be a lawyer among the survivors who can plead his case.

objectives.description: Rescue survivors to find a defense attorney

quest:s11_protectsurvivor_quest_h1.name: [PH] Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Outlander
quest:s11_protectsurvivor_quest_h1.description: [PH] Homebase picked up a strange transmission. It sounds like someone needs help!

objectives.description: [PH] Find and protect the Tinkerer

quest:s11_reactivefetch_quest_a2.name: Day 2
quest:s11_reactivefetch_quest_a2.description: Investigate clues to learn more about the hauntings in the hotel. Must be completed during a Survive the Night mission.

objectives.description: Investigate clues in the hotel

quest:s11_reactivefetch_quest_h7.name: Monkey Times
quest:s11_reactivefetch_quest_h7.description: Ted and his creations are set on reclaiming his creative spark. Find crafting supplies to help: a mannequin head, sewing machine, collection of thread, bolts of cloth, and cans of dye.

objectives.description: Collect crafting supplies for Ted
Collect Thread
Collect Bolts of Cloth
Collect Mannequin Head
Collect Dye
Collect Sewing Machine

quest:s11_reactivekill_quest_c7.name: OW. YOUR EYE.
quest:s11_reactivekill_quest_c7.description: Join forces with the slashers by showing you can think like them. Use bladed weapons to eliminate enemies Hint: Use swords, scythes, or axes. Cannot be completed in the Haunted Hotel.

objectives.description: Eliminate enemies using blade weapons

quest:s11_reactivekill_quest_f0.name: Bonus: More Holiday Fear
quest:s11_reactivekill_quest_f0.description: Husks continue to make a mockery of the holidays. Crackshot is satisfied with the current spread of holiday fear, but more would make him even more joyful!

objectives.description: Eliminate more Santa Husky Husks and Mrs. Claus Lobbers

quest:s11_reactivekill_quest_f2.name: Holiday Fear
quest:s11_reactivekill_quest_f2.description: Husks have been making a mockery of the season by wearing discourteous costumes. Crackshot demands Santa Husky Husks and Mrs. Claus Lobbers be taught a lesson.

objectives.description: Eliminate Santa Husky Husks and Mrs. Claus Lobbers

quest:s11_reactivekill_quest_g4.name: Slayride
quest:s11_reactivekill_quest_g4.description: Remind Willow of some of her favorite haunts by eliminating Husks with traps.

objectives.description: Eliminate enemies with traps

quest:s11_rescuehero_quest_h1.name: Day Of The Living Ted
quest:s11_rescuehero_quest_h1.description: A survivor named Ted is on the run and needs Homebase's help. Find him in the storm and bring him back to safety.

objectives.description: Find and rescue Ted

quest:s12_buildradar_quest_b7.name: Your Own Boss
quest:s12_buildradar_quest_b7.description: Knox wants to try this "Constructor" thing. Help him by building a radar tower.

objectives.description: Build a radar tower for Knox.

quest:s12_collect_quest_b4.name: Why We Fight
quest:s12_collect_quest_b4.description: Knox and Lars found survivors near the storm. Get out there and rescue them!

objectives.description: Rescue survivors found by Knox.

quest:s12_danceemote_quest_a6.name: I'm Only Dancing
quest:s12_danceemote_quest_a6.description: Ray wants to convince Homebase that love is worth the risk. The best way to accomplish this is to dance! Hint: Use a dance emote at the marked locations in the area.

objectives.description: Dance at marked dance locations

quest:s12_fetch_quest_a2.name: Disco Demolition
quest:s12_fetch_quest_a2.description: Ray has convinced Farrah to not destroy Homebase's capacity for love, instead they are going to destroy dance floors.

objectives.description: Place devices to destroy dance floors

quest:s12_fetch_quest_a3.name: Loveless
quest:s12_fetch_quest_a3.description: Farrah has commissioned Lars to write a song which captures the anti-love spirit. Help by finding boxes of break-up materials to inspire the musician.

objectives.description: Find boxes of anti-love memorabilia

quest:s12_fetch_quest_a4.name: Songs of Hate and Hate
quest:s12_fetch_quest_a4.description: Lars is ready to debut his newest song inspired by the tragic break ups found in the discarded boxes. Deploy speakers in the area to blast the somber tune.

objectives.description: Deploy speakers to play Lars' new song

quest:s12_fetch_quest_a5.name: Forbidden Love
quest:s12_fetch_quest_a5.description: Major Oswald isn't giving up on his mission. Help spread anti-love propaganda by deploying flyer cannons.

objectives.description: Deploy flyer cannons to spread anti-love propaganda

quest:s12_fetch_quest_b1.name: Henchin'
quest:s12_fetch_quest_b1.description: Many personnel files were lost during the latest husk attack. Help the Director find hard copies of the files by searching old filing cabinets and uncover Knox's past.

objectives.description: Search filing cabinets for personnel files on Knox.

quest:s12_fetch_quest_b5.name: It's Like A Dare
quest:s12_fetch_quest_b5.description: Helping people, not hurting people. Now that the survivors are safe, help Knox gather supplies for them. Basic supplies. Very basic. HINT: Find stacks of toilet paper in bathrooms.

objectives.description: Search abandoned shelters and homes for toilet paper.

quest:s12_gathercollect_quest_a1.name: You're No Good
quest:s12_gathercollect_quest_a1.description: Major Oswald has enlisted the help of Farrah to stop the spread of love. Her first suggestion is to deliver disheartening letters to the team of Homebase. Hint: Best found in Urban and Suburban zones.

objectives.description: Destroy mailboxes to collect envelopes

quest:s12_gathercollect_quest_b2.name: Right In The Zeus
quest:s12_gathercollect_quest_b2.description: Knox needs parts from vehicles to fix Lars' van. Help by breaking down abandoned vehicles to find what's needed. HINT: Parts best found in City and Suburb zones.

objectives.description: Gather vehicle parts by destroying vehicles.

quest:s12_killcollect_quest_b6.name: The Test
quest:s12_killcollect_quest_b6.description: THERAPYBOT has been asked to evaluate Knox, but the answer keys were stolen by husks. Eliminate Pitcher and Zapper husks and recover the answer booklets!

objectives.description: Eliminate Pitcher and Zapper husks to collect answer booklets

quest:s12_reactivekill_quest_a7.name: Leap of Faith
quest:s12_reactivekill_quest_a7.description: Love is back! The love lobbers are also out in force. Eliminate as many as you can to prevent heartbreak.

objectives.description: Eliminate love lobbers

quest:s12_reactivekill_quest_b3.name: Hero Training
quest:s12_reactivekill_quest_b3.description: Show Knox what it takes to be a hero. Eliminate Mist Monsters or 'Sploders to show him how its done!

objectives.description: Eliminate Mist Monsters and 'Sploders!

quest:s13_destroy_quest_a2.name: Lights Out
quest:s13_destroy_quest_a2.description: The now thoroughly dead pirate Blakebeard, wants to show the worlds of the living and the dead that he is a villain of the highest caliber. To usher in this new age of dread, destroy Lanterns and plunge the world into darkness!

objectives.description: Destroy Lanterns in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s13_destroy_quest_a4.name: Sucker Punch
quest:s13_destroy_quest_a4.description: Willow has placed poisoned punch throughout the world to swell Blakebeard's ranks with ghost pirates. Destroy the punch before her diabolical plan can succeed.

objectives.description: Destroy Barrels of Poisoned Punch in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s13_fetch_quest_a3.name: Ghost to Coast
quest:s13_fetch_quest_a3.description: In attempt to show Blakebeard what it really is like in the afterlife, Willow trapped ghosts so they can provide the pirate with accounts of being dead. Find the ghost cages to hear their stories.

objectives.description: Collect Ghost Cages in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s13_fetch_quest_a5.name: I See Shanties
quest:s13_fetch_quest_a5.description: Blakebeard's friends wrote sea shanties about the pirate's exploits. Find Boomboxes throughout the land so everyone can hear these catchy tunes.

objectives.description: Find Boomboxes in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s13_fetch_quest_a6.name: The Red Doubloons
quest:s13_fetch_quest_a6.description: What is a legendary ghost pirate without a stash of plundered treasure? Find sacks of doubloons to add to Blakebeard's ill-gotten riches.

objectives.description: Collect Stashes of Treasure in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s13_gathercollect_quest_a10.name: Don't Steal My Coconuts
quest:s13_gathercollect_quest_a10.description: One of the most basic rules for survival is to find nourishment. Destroy palm trees to collect coconuts to eat.

objectives.description: Destroy palm trees and collect coconuts in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s13_gathercollect_quest_a9.name: Tales From the Loophole
quest:s13_gathercollect_quest_a9.description: To prove he is hero material, Riggs must find a way to reorient himself when lost in the storm. Destroy runic boulders to find hidden maps and help him find his way.

objectives.description: Destroy runic boulders and collect treasure maps in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s13_killcollect_quest_a7.name: King Hat
quest:s13_killcollect_quest_a7.description: The highest honor to bestow on a pirate is being crowned a Pirate King. Eliminate Husky Husks and find a suitable crown for Blakebeard.

objectives.description: Eliminate Husky Husks and Collect Crowns in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s13_killcollect_quest_a8.name: Oh That's What It's Good For
quest:s13_killcollect_quest_a8.description: Now that Blakebeard is satisfied, Riggs is the one in crisis. To get some perspective, hunt lobbers and collect their telescopes to survey the land.

objectives.description: Eliminate Lobbers and Collect Telescopes in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s13_landmark_quest_a1.name: Pirate Attack!
quest:s13_landmark_quest_a1.description: Homebase is under attack by a mob of pirates! Complete the Yarrr's Return mission in Scurvy Shoals

objectives.description: Complete Yarrr's Return mission

quest:s13_rescuesurvivors_quest_a11.name: With Honors
quest:s13_rescuesurvivors_quest_a11.description: Riggs is confident that he is ready for action. Head out into the zone and rescue some survivors!

objectives.description: Rescue survivors in Scurvy Shoals

quest:s9_destroy_quest_a6.name: The Major, the Lok, and the Wardrobes
quest:s9_destroy_quest_a6.description: Help Lok overcome his fears by destroying potential monster hiding places.

objectives.description: Destroy closets that may harbor monsters in Suburban and Urban zones

quest:s9_fetch_quest_a1.name: Lok Out
quest:s9_fetch_quest_a1.description: Lok has gone missing. Use his flier cannons to distribute missing posters.

objectives.description: Activate the flier cannons

quest:s9_fetch_quest_a11.name: TV Party
quest:s9_fetch_quest_a11.description: Help Jess take the easy way out.

objectives.description: Collect televisions for Lok in Suburban and Urban zones

quest:s9_fetch_quest_a13.name: Monster Hunters
quest:s9_fetch_quest_a13.description: We've found the area from Lok's broadcast. The monster should be nearby.

objectives.description: Search the zone for signs of Lok's monster

quest:s9_fetch_quest_a14.name: Ding!
quest:s9_fetch_quest_a14.description: Well... Lok was right. We'd better find a way to learn more about his monster encounter.

objectives.description: Search the zone for printer paper in Suburban, Urban, and Industrial zones

quest:s9_fetch_quest_a2.name: Post Mortem
quest:s9_fetch_quest_a2.description: Find out who's responsible for Lok's lock out by reviewing security footage.

objectives.description: Collect security footage in Suburban and Urban zones

quest:s9_fetch_quest_a3.name: Is This Your Monster?
quest:s9_fetch_quest_a3.description: Search the zone to find Lok's monster.

objectives.description: Search the zone for gargoyles

quest:s9_fetch_quest_a7.name: Dennosaur
quest:s9_fetch_quest_a7.description: Dennis has a plan, and it involves dinosaurs - You know what to do.

objectives.description: Collect dinosaur toys in Suburban, Urban, and Industrial zones

quest:s9_fetch_quest_a9.name: Self Care
quest:s9_fetch_quest_a9.description: Luna's in charge, and that means it's time to relax and play games. Collect arcade games to get the party started.

objectives.description: Collect arcade games in Suburban, Urban, and Industrial zones

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b1.name: And I am Her Cap'n
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b1.description: Cap'n Azalea Clark has been spotted at Homebase. It's time to binge watch Beyond The Stellar Horizon.

objectives.description: Collect episodes of Beyond The Stellar Horizon

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b10.name: Troll-bles
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b10.description: Every film production has a troll problem or two. Deploy anti-troll vacuums and take back what's ours.

objectives.description: Deploy troll vacuums over dormant troll dens

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b11.name: ADR
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b11.description: ED-EE is in space and we have no time to recast. Deploy antennas to record his dialogue from orbit.

objectives.description: Deploy communication antennas

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b13.name: The Produce-ers
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b13.description: The movie is a disaster! Collect mushy tomatoes before they can be thrown in our faces!

objectives.description: Collect mushy tomatoes

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b14.name: Red Carpet
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b14.description: We may need to provide some escape routes from the premiere. Collect red carpets.

objectives.description: Gather red carpets

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b15.name: Splash Down
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b15.description: ED-EE is coming home. Deploy pillows to give him a safe landing.

objectives.description: Deploy emergency landing pillows

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b3.name: Vision
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b3.description: Pre-production is a go! Find cameras and prepare for filming.

objectives.description: Search the zone for cameras

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b6.name: Bat to Business
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b6.description: Lure Ken back into the acting game by tracking down his iconic catchphrase.

objectives.description: Search the zone for Ken's iconic catchphrase

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b7.name: Park Bench Scene
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b7.description: Script pages are coming in! Track down the best scenes you can find.

objectives.description: Collect script pages

quest:s9_fetch_quest_b9.name: Cinéma-Vérité
quest:s9_fetch_quest_b9.description: Okay, the script is not great. We're gonna need some very special effects. Collect rocket parts.

objectives.description: Search the zone for rocket parts in Industrial zones

quest:s9_gather_quest_a8.name: It Goes Where It Goes
quest:s9_gather_quest_a8.description: Help Dennis test out his latest invention.

objectives.description: Collect teddy bears in Suburban zones

quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_a12.name: Crash Course
quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_a12.description: Find books to pinpoint the location of Lok's television projection.

objectives.description: Destroy bookcases to collect books in Suburban and Urban zones

quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_a15.name: To Be Continued
quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_a15.description: Is this monster encounter a stand alone feature? A trilogy? A prequel? Dennis will decide...

objectives.description: Collect video editing software in Urban zones

quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_a4.name: We'll Have the Quinoa
quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_a4.description: Help Dennis prepare for open-bot surgery by collecting parts for a post surgery incubation oven.

objectives.description: Destroy ovens to collect heating elements in Suburban zones

quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_b5.name: ED-EE
quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_b5.description: Help Azalea find everything she needs to rebuild ED-EE.

objectives.description: Collect ED-EE parts in Industrial zones

quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_b8.name: Table Read
quest:s9_gathercollect_quest_b8.description: Time to see what our writers have come up with. It's probably fine.

objectives.description: Gather table parts
(Hidden) Watch S9 Video

quest:s9_killcollect_quest_a10.name: Din. Er
quest:s9_killcollect_quest_a10.description: The beast must feed! Help Din.0 feast on mist monster samples.

objectives.description: Gather mist monster samples

quest:s9_killcollect_quest_a5.name: Major Spoilers
quest:s9_killcollect_quest_a5.description: Husklings have raided the Homebase gold supply. Take 'em out and return the missing rings.

objectives.description: Take out husklings and collect golden rings

quest:s9_killcollect_quest_b4.name: Headshots
quest:s9_killcollect_quest_b4.description: The casting office has been raided by husks. Get those headshots back!

objectives.description: Take out the husks and collect the missing headshots
Re-shoot key scenes with CG-Bot

quest:s9_landmark_quest_b2.name: Backstage
quest:s9_landmark_quest_b2.description: The Beyond the Stellar Horizon soundstage has been found. Explore the set!

objectives.description: Search the Beyond the Stellar Horizon soundstage

quest:scavengerquest_completeexpeditions.name: Leave No Stone Unturned
quest:scavengerquest_completeexpeditions.description:
Well done, Commander! You can now send your Heroes on Expeditions. If an Expedition is successful, you receive rewards! Your Heroes will need People and Vehicles to accompany them. Expeditions take time to complete and are not guaranteed to succeed.

Visit the Command tab to assign your Heroes on an Expedition.
After an Expedition has been completed, go back to the Expeditions Squads tab and see if it was successful!

objectives.description: Successfully complete 5 Expeditions

quest:springquest_2018_reactive_cctv_cam.name: Creature Features

objectives.description: Deploy 5 Leprechaun Traps

quest:springquest_2018_reactive_potsofgo.name: Fool's Gold
quest:springquest_2018_reactive_potsofgo.description: Commander, there's free gold EVERYWHERE! Oh, and on an unrelated note, we have reports there's a new storm hazard luring people into dangerous situations. So get out there and don't come back until we're rich!

objectives.description: Search the zone for Storm Gold

quest:starlightquest_complete_dailies_3.description: The final test of your dedication to Dungeon destruction! Successfully complete 10 total Daily Dungeon quests to finally become a Daily Dungeon Destroyer!

quest:starlightquest_complete_melee_time.description: Complete the Melee Only Timed Run challenge for The Crypts!

In subsequent Dungeon seasons, this quest will no longer be necessary since the Crypts quest will grant the first Lab quest as a quest reward.

objectives.description: (Hidden) Complete first Crypts quest.

quest:starlightquest_kill_mimics.name: Dungeon Treasure?
quest:starlightquest_kill_mimics.description: There is a ton of treasure to find in the Dungeons! But, it looks like not all of it is willing to go peacefully. Eliminate Mimics in successful Dungeon missions.

objectives.description: Eliminate 5 Mimics in successful Dungeon missions.

Get teleported by a Teleport Dungeon Trap.

quest:stonewoodquest_filler_1_d3.name: Rescue the Survivors
quest:stonewoodquest_filler_1_d3.description: Survivors are in danger. Complete a Rescue the Survivors mission.

objectives.description: Complete a Rescue the Survivors mission in a 5+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_filler_1_d4.name: Leave Only Footprints
quest:stonewoodquest_filler_1_d4.description: The husks have done us wrong, let's go do 'em in. Clear husk encampments and search for more.

objectives.description: Clear 4 Husk Encampments in successful missions in a 9+ zone
Complete 2 missions in a 9+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_filler_2_d4.name: Medic!
quest:stonewoodquest_filler_2_d4.description: Stock up on healing! Craft 5 Healing Pads, and complete 2 missions.

objectives.description: Craft Healing Pads
Complete 2 missions in a 5+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_filler_2_d5.name: Countdown
quest:stonewoodquest_filler_2_d5.description: Smashers and Takers are on the rampage. Defeat those Mist Monsters!

objectives.description: Eliminate 5 Mist Monsters in a 15+ zone
Complete 3 missions in a 15+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_gathercollect_armor.name: Up in Arms
quest:stonewoodquest_gathercollect_armor.description: The armory needs an upgrade. Gather machine parts by destroying industrial machinery to upgrade the manufacturing and modding capacity of the armory.

objectives.description: Collect Machine Parts in a 15+ Industrial zone
(Hidden) Collect 50 Items

quest:stonewoodquest_joelkarolina_killhu.name: Husk Takedown
quest:stonewoodquest_joelkarolina_killhu.description: Take out those husks! Take them all down!

objectives.description: Eliminate Husks in a 40+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_joelkarolina_killmi.name: Mist Monster Hunter
quest:stonewoodquest_joelkarolina_killmi.description: Let’s see what you can do against the mist monsters!

objectives.description: Eliminate Mist Monsters in a 40+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_joelkarolina_savesu.name: Save the World
quest:stonewoodquest_joelkarolina_savesu.description: Survivors are in need of rescue! Save as many as you can!

objectives.description: Save Survivors

quest:stonewoodquest_killcollect_mistmon.name: Horrors from the Mist
quest:stonewoodquest_killcollect_mistmon.description: Gather as much data as you can from the Mist Monsters to prepare for a showdown with the Storm King.

objectives.description: Collect Mist Monster data in a 15+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_landmark_buildoff.name: Build Off!
quest:stonewoodquest_landmark_buildoff.description: It's a build off between Kyle and Penny! Complete a Constructor Build Off mission.

objectives.description: Complete the Constructor Build Off mission

quest:stonewoodquest_launchballoon_d1.name: Ride the Lightning
quest:stonewoodquest_launchballoon_d1.description: Meet freelance storm analyst / potentially dangerous weirdo, Lars.

objectives.description: Complete a Ride the Lightning mission

quest:stonewoodquest_launchrocket_d5.name: Van or Astro-van?
quest:stonewoodquest_launchrocket_d5.description: We've got blue skies and a rocket that's almost ready to fly. Get out there and launch your next Storm Shield.

objectives.description: Complete a Launch the Rocket mission in a 15+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_mechanical_buildlev.name: Build Off 2: Reinforcement
quest:stonewoodquest_mechanical_buildlev.description: Kyle and Penny's final build off! Let's build some more structures!

objectives.description: Build Level 2 Structures in a 9+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_mechanical_killhusk.name: Recruit Training
quest:stonewoodquest_mechanical_killhusk.description: It's time to teach our defender trainee how to fight. Take on those husks!

objectives.description: Eliminate Husks with Melee Weapons in a 15+ zone in Stonewood
Eliminate Husks with Ranged Weapons in a 15+ zone in Stonewood
Eliminate Husks with Traps in a 15+ zone in Stonewood

quest:stonewoodquest_reactive_fetch_hove.name: Want to Build a Hoverboard?
quest:stonewoodquest_reactive_fetch_hove.description: I just realized you don't have a Hoverboard! Let's fix that. Destroy Hot Rods to collect everything we'll need to build a Hoverboard.

objectives.description: Search City Zones for Hot Rods in a 9+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_reactive_joelkaroli.name: Portraits of Someone Special
quest:stonewoodquest_reactive_joelkaroli.description: Look for portraits of Karolina while ridding the world of husks and monsters. Most often found in the attics of old houses.

objectives.description: Gather Portraits of Karolina in a 40+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_reactive_joelkaroli.name: Joel's Pub
quest:stonewoodquest_reactive_joelkaroli.description: Time to enjoy some downtime. Visit Joel's pubs while completing some missions.

objectives.description: Become a regular at Joel's Pub by visiting it on two occasions in a 40+ zone. Found in City zones.

quest:stonewoodquest_retrievedata_d1.name: Retrieve the Data
quest:stonewoodquest_retrievedata_d1.description: A research balloon is heading for hostile territory. Save the balloon and recover the intel.

objectives.description: Complete a Retrieve the Data mission

quest:stonewoodquest_side_1_d3.name: Troll Thieves
quest:stonewoodquest_side_1_d3.description: Whack some Trolls and reclaim that BluGlo!

objectives.description: Whack 2 Trolls in successful missions in a 5+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_side_1_d4.name: Group Effort
quest:stonewoodquest_side_1_d4.description:
It's time to join up with other Commanders and complete a mission in Stonewood!

This Quest must be completed in Stonewood.

objectives.description: Complete 2 Play with Others missions in Stonewood

quest:stonewoodquest_side_1_d5.name: The Prestige
quest:stonewoodquest_side_1_d5.description: If you can't handle Stonewood at its worst, you don't deserve those 15 survivors...

objectives.description: Save 15 Survivors
Complete 3 missions in a 15+ zone

quest:stonewoodquest_treasuredfriends.name: Treasured Friends
quest:stonewoodquest_treasuredfriends.description: Go on a treasure hunt to stock up on weapons, ammo, traps, and crafting resources. Quest progress is shared with the group.

objectives.description: Loot a Treasure Chest in a 3+ zone

quest:stormking_checkemail.name: Storm King Pin
quest:stormking_checkemail.description: Congratulations! You have defeated the Storm King! Check your email over the next several days for information on getting a physical Storm King Pin!

objectives.description: (Hidden) Check Email

quest:stormking_daily_landmark_bossfight.name: Kingslayer
quest:stormking_daily_landmark_bossfight.description: Defeat the Storm King! Are you up for this Daily Challenge?

objectives.description: Defeat the Storm King

quest:stormking_hidden_hascompletedquest.name: (Hidden) Canny Valley Bossfight Progression Quest
quest:stormking_hidden_hascompletedquest.description: (Hidden) Grants follow up quest to tell players to check email for more information on how to get their physical pin.

objectives.description: (Hidden) Complete Canny Valley Bossfight Quest

quest:stormquest_2018_completestormzones.name: Endless Storms
quest:stormquest_2018_completestormzones.description: Storms are rapidly spreading. Look at all that purple turbulance on the map! Complete some missions in those hexes. Note: This is a repeatable Quest.

objectives.description: Complete 2 Mutant Storm missions

quest:stormquest_2018_completesurvive7da.name: Against All Odds
quest:stormquest_2018_completesurvive7da.description:
Survive the Storm for 7 days in a Power 15 zone.

You can access Survive the Storm by selecting the Map tab and then selecting the Survive the Storm pin.

objectives.description: Complete a 7 Day Survive the Storm in a 15 zone

quest:stormquest_2018_completesurvive7da.name: The Will to Survive
quest:stormquest_2018_completesurvive7da.description:
Survive a 7 Day mission in a Power 40 zone.

You can access Survive the Storm by selecting the Map tab and then selecting the Survive the Storm pin.

objectives.description: Complete a 7 Day Survive the Storm in a 40 zone

quest:stormquest_2018_completesurvive7da.name: Only the Strong Survive
quest:stormquest_2018_completesurvive7da.description:
A 7 Day mission in a Power 70 zone? Can you survive?

You can access Survive the Storm by selecting the Map tab and then selecting the Survive the Storm pin.

objectives.description: Complete a 7 Day Survive the Storm in a 70 zone

quest:stormquest_2018_completesurviveany.name: Into The Storm
quest:stormquest_2018_completesurviveany.description:
Successfully complete Survive the Storm missions in any threat level.

You can access Survive the Storm by selecting the Map tab and then selecting the Survive the Storm pin.

objectives.description: Complete 3 Survive the Storm missions
(Hidden) Complete StormQuest_2018_Reactive_SkyAtlases

quest:stormquest_2018_hidden_watchvideo.name: (Hidden) Into the Storm Watch Video Quest

objectives.description: (Hidden) Watch Into the Storm Video

quest:stormquest_2018_landmark_lars.name: Steel Icarus
quest:stormquest_2018_landmark_lars.description: Launch Lars deep into the storm!

objectives.description: Launch Lars beyond the wall of clouds

quest:stormquest_2018_landmark_observe.name: Reunion Tour
quest:stormquest_2018_landmark_observe.description: It's time to finish Carlos' research! Protect the telescope array until the results come in!

objectives.description: Defend the telescope array (4 telescopes) while they are observing the sky

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_acparts.name: Cleverboards
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_acparts.description: Commander, I have come up with a foolproof hoverboard based plan to track Carlos down! The only problem is, these hoverboards are idiots! I need your help. Searching rooftops for AC units should help us find the parts we need. Found in Urban, Suburban and Industrial zones.

objectives.description: Gather AC control circuits from AC units for the Smart Hoverboards

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_equipment.name: Last Known Position
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_equipment.description: Lars has asked us not to search for Carlos. So let's play it cool... as we search the rooftops for Carlos' research equipment. Found mostly in Urban, Suburban and Industrial zones.

objectives.description: Find and interact with the research equipment someone's been installing on the rooftops

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_hoverboar.name: Hover Over Yonder
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_hoverboar.description: We don't have time to train the hoverfleet, but I think they'll figure it out. Head out and launch those brilliant boards!

objectives.description: Deploy smart hoverboards on their journey

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_huskdata.name: Its What's Inside That Counts
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_huskdata.description: We need husk data... the gross kind of husk data. So take no prisoners and collect all samples!

objectives.description: Eliminate and collect mist monster data

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_insulator.name: Iron Van
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_insulator.description: Lars is not going to like it, but we need to upgrade his van for the journey into the storm.Gather the insulators from electrical transformers. Found mostly in Industrial zones.

objectives.description: Find insulators from power transformers around the world

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_maps.name: Oh, Wait. Maps!
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_maps.description: If we're going to head out west, we'll need maps. Search the industrial zone for vehicles likely to have maps. Trucks are easiest to find in Industrial zones.

objectives.description: Gather maps from Trucks and RVs

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_payphones.name: What's A Payphone?
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_payphones.description: The Hover Fleet is calling back! Track down payphones to collect their reports. Found in Urban, Suburban and Industrial zones.

objectives.description: Find public payphones the smart hoverboards are calling and retrieve the data

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_records.name: Liner Notes
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_records.description: Steel Wool mania is sweeping Homebase. Scour the streets for anything Steel Wool related. Found mostly in Urban and Suburban zones.

objectives.description: Look for Steel Wool album records

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_research.name: Deep Cuts
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_research.description: Lars' sensor upgrade is a success, but no one can understand the new data. The answer to this strange data may lie in Lars' past. Search any basements to find Lars' old research. Found in Urban, Suburban and Industrial zones.

objectives.description: Find Lars's old research data

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_servers.name: Van Down!
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_servers.description: Help Lars restore his van's systems by collecting backup data from any server racks you can find. Found mostly in Urban and Industrial zones.

objectives.description: Find server clusters in the world and use them for some number-crunching

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_serviceca.name: Breaker! Breaker!
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_serviceca.description: Lars' van can't keep up with the strange new developments in the sky. Blast open the Van's doors of perception by collecting encrypted radio components from emergency response vehicles.

objectives.description: Destroy firetrucks, police cars and ambulances to retrieve Encrypted Radio parts

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_skyatlase.name: Stars, Man.
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_skyatlase.description: Lars hasn't slept in days and his vital signs do not look good. Let's check in to see what he needs before he crashes his van. The sky atlases can be found mostly in Urban and Suburban zones.

objectives.description: Find sky atlas parts by destroying bookshelves

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_speakers.name: Encore
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_speakers.description: Lars is ready to rock. Who are we to stand in the way?

objectives.description: Deploy speakers and blast Steel Wool's greatest hits to repel the storm

quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_telescope.name: Eye Spy
quest:stormquest_2018_reactive_telescope.description: Lars wants telescopes... I have no idea why. Search for telescope parts and I'll figure our what Lars is up to. Found in Urban, Suburban and Industrial zones.

objectives.description: Find broken telescopes that we could use to construct a telescope array

quest:stw_stormkinghard_firsttakedown.name: Regicide
quest:stw_stormkinghard_firsttakedown.description: They say the bigger they are, the harder they fall. We certainly hope that is the case with this new Storm King. Good luck, Commander!

objectives.description: Eliminate the Mythic Storm King

quest:stw_stormkinghard_kingme.name: King Me
quest:stw_stormkinghard_kingme.description: The Storm King's minions are tough and should provide a great way to hone your skills. They are also blocking the way to the Storm King, so eliminating them is not really optional.

objectives.description: Eliminate 2 Epic Mini-Bosses in a 140+ zone

quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_001.name: (Weekly) Scions of the Storm King: Mimics
quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_001.description: The Storm King's power grows! Hunt down mimics to slow him down.

objectives.description: Defeat 2 Mimics in Successful Missions in 140+ Zones

quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_002.name: (Weekly) Scions of the Storm King: Storm Chests
quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_002.description: The Storm King's power grows! Open Storm Chests to hinder him!

objectives.description: Complete a Storm Chest in Successful Missions in 140+ Zones

quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_003.name: (Weekly) Scions of the Storm King: Minibosses
quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_003.description: The Storm King's power grows! Defeat Minibosses to take out his support!

objectives.description: Defeat 3 Minibosses in 140+ Zones

quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_004.name: (Weekly) Scions of the Storm King: Mist Monsters
quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_004.description: The Storm King's power grows! Fight back the Mist Monsters surging as a result!

objectives.description: Eliminate 20 Mist Monsters in 140+ Zones.

quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_005.name: (Weekly) Scions of the Storm King: Survivors
quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_005.description: The Storm King's power grows! Save the Survivors affected before it's too late!

objectives.description: Rescue 10 Survivors in 140+ Zones

quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_006.name: (Weekly) Scions of the Storm King: Defend the Van
quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_006.description: The Storm King's power grows! We need to survey the Storm for changes!

objectives.description: Complete 3 Ride the Lightning missions in 140+ Zones

quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_007.name: (Weekly) Scions of the Storm King: Elemental Husks
quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_007.description: The Storm King's power grows! Deal with the Elemental Husks that have surged as a result!

objectives.description: Eliminate 300 Elementals in 140+ Zones

quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_showdown.name: (Weekly) Defeat the Mythic Storm King!
quest:stw_stormkinghard_weekly_showdown.description: You've weakened the Storm King! Now's the time to strike! Send him packing!

objectives.description: Defeat the Mythic Storm King.

quest:stwirwinintro_build_quest_a7.name: Buildasaurus Rex
quest:stwirwinintro_build_quest_a7.description: Distract the raptor forces with a perfectly built dino distraction.

objectives.description: Build a dino distraction

quest:stwirwinintro_feed_quest_a2.name: The Wolf Snack
quest:stwirwinintro_feed_quest_a2.description: Bribe Gia's wolf pack and other animals into spilling their secrets with tasty treats.

objectives.description: Feed the animals.

quest:stwirwinintro_fetch_quest_a3.name: The Most Dangerous Tame
quest:stwirwinintro_fetch_quest_a3.description: Help Ray and Gia bring peace to the wilds of Homebase with a no holds barred taming spree.

objectives.description: Tame Animals

quest:stwirwinintro_fetch_quest_a5.name: Not to Boar You
quest:stwirwinintro_fetch_quest_a5.description: Harness the searching skills the animal kingdom by joining a boar scavenger hunt.

objectives.description: Harness the boar's searching skills.

quest:stwirwinintro_reactivekill_quest_a.name: Brawl of the Wild
quest:stwirwinintro_reactivekill_quest_a.description: Go on a wild game hunt to help Ray and Dennis take on the dangerous animal invasion.

objectives.description: Eliminate the wild animals.

quest:stwirwinintro_reactivekill_quest_a.name: The Attack Pack
quest:stwirwinintro_reactivekill_quest_a.description: Eliminate wolfy confusion by teaching the pack to take out the husk horde.

objectives.description: Eliminate husks with a tamed wolf.

quest:stwirwinintro_reactivekill_quest_a.name: In the Hall of the Raptor Queen
quest:stwirwinintro_reactivekill_quest_a.description: Help the Raptor Queen cleanse her kingdom of mist monsters.

objectives.description: Eliminate Mist Monsters with a tamed raptor.

quest:stwirwinraptor_quest_a01_hatching.name: Don’t Bite the Hand that Tames
quest:stwirwinraptor_quest_a01_hatching.description: Show that you are the ultimate raptor wrangler by taming two raptors.

objectives.description: Tame 2 raptors

quest:stwirwinraptor_quest_a03_riding.name: Raptor Rodeo
quest:stwirwinraptor_quest_a03_riding.description: Prove you’re a real raptor riding pro by traveling 1000m on raptor-back.

objectives.description: Travel 1000m while riding a raptor

quest:stwirwinraptor_quest_a04_eliminate.name: Ricochet Ranger
quest:stwirwinraptor_quest_a04_eliminate.description: Eliminate 50 husks while riding any wildlife to prove your mounted combat skills!

objectives.description: Eliminate 50 husks while riding wildlife
