quest:summerquest_2019_complete_all.name: Take a Bow
quest:summerquest_2019_complete_all.description: The party was a smash success, take a bow. You deserve it.

objectives.description: Complete "Get Ready to Party..."
Complete "Make That a COLD Drink"
Complete "Batter Up!"
Complete "Party Games"
Complete "Towel off!"
Complete "Hit the Hoops"
Complete "Summer Bummer"
Complete "Party Decor"
Complete "Find the Fun"
Complete "Light'em Up"
Complete "Party Crashers"
Complete "No Mow"
Complete "Beat the Heat"
Complete "Did We Forget Something?"

quest:summerquest_2019_fetch_fireworks.name: Find the Fun
quest:summerquest_2019_fetch_fireworks.description: No summer party is complete without a fireworks show! We’ll need a lot of them if we want our party booming.

objectives.description: Collect boxes of fireworks

quest:summerquest_2019_fetch_flamingo.name: Party Decor
quest:summerquest_2019_fetch_flamingo.description: We're not going to make the slideshow of 10 Homebase Parties With Pizzaz if we don't have decorations!

objectives.description: Collect flamingo lawn ornaments

quest:summerquest_2019_fetch_towels.name: Towel Off!
quest:summerquest_2019_fetch_towels.description: There's a soggy emergency on the pool deck! Find towels! Hint: These are easiest found in city or surburban missions.

objectives.description: Collect pool towels

quest:summerquest_2019_fetch_water.name: Get Ready to Party…
quest:summerquest_2019_fetch_water.description: What better way to celebrate the summer than hosting a party? Start it off right by getting something to drink for our guests...

objectives.description: Collect jugs of water

quest:summerquest_2019_gather_air_condit.name: Beat the Heat
quest:summerquest_2019_gather_air_condit.description: The people of Homebase are officially too hot to party! Collect air conditioning parts to chill everyone out.

objectives.description: Harvest air conditioner units to collect their parts

quest:summerquest_2019_harvest_basketbal.name: Hit the Hoops
quest:summerquest_2019_harvest_basketbal.description: The Twine Bounders are set to take on the Plankerton Smashers in the first annual Homebase Playoffs... we should probably build a court. Collect basketball hoops.  Hint: These are easiest found in suburban missions.

objectives.description: Collect parts from basketball hoops

quest:summerquest_2019_harvest_lawnmower.name: No Mow
quest:summerquest_2019_harvest_lawnmower.description: If the world has ended, why are we still mowing the lawn? Let’s destroy all remnants of that ancient chore and harvest their parts! Hint: These are easiest found in suburban missions.

objectives.description: Harvest lawn mower parts

quest:summerquest_2019_kill_200.name: Party Crashers
quest:summerquest_2019_kill_200.description: We've got party crashers! Take 'em out!

objectives.description: Eliminate husks

quest:summerquest_2019_kill_melee.name: Batter Up!
quest:summerquest_2019_kill_melee.description: Warm up for the 2nd annual Homebase Softball Extravaganza by taking a swing at some husks.

objectives.description: Eliminate husks with melee

quest:summerquest_2019_kill_mist.name: Summer Bummer
quest:summerquest_2019_kill_mist.description: We have reports of misty party crashers. Take 'em out!

objectives.description: Eliminate mist monsters of any type

quest:summerquest_2019_kill_wargames.name: Party Games
quest:summerquest_2019_kill_wargames.description: Nothing gets a party started like a fun ice breaker. Get the fun started with some Wargames. Access Wargames from the Storm Shield Computer in your Homebase or by assisting other players via Neighborhood Watch.

objectives.description: Complete two Wargames simulations

quest:summerquest_2019_light_fireworks.name: Light'em Up
quest:summerquest_2019_light_fireworks.description: Let's celebrate this party with a bang!

objectives.description: Light off the fireworks

quest:summerquest_2019_rescue_survivors.name: Did We Forget Something?
quest:summerquest_2019_rescue_survivors.description: Ray sort of, uh, forgot to send out the last batch of invites for the Summer party. Looks like we’ll need to find some people!

objectives.description: Rescue survivors

quest:summerquest_2019_search_ice.name: Make That a COLD Drink
quest:summerquest_2019_search_ice.description: What good is a warm drink for our summer party? Go get some ice.

objectives.description: Destroy ice machines, freezers, or refrigerators to collect ice

quest:survivalmodequest_14days_d1.name: Fortnite for a Fortnight
quest:survivalmodequest_14days_d1.description:
Survive the Storm for 14 days in a Power 15 zone.

You can access Survive the Storm by selecting the Map tab and then selecting the Survive the Storm pin.

objectives.description: Complete a 14 Day Survive the Storm mission in a 15 zone

quest:survivalmodequest_14days_d2.name: True Survivor
quest:survivalmodequest_14days_d2.description:
Make it like a True Survivor! Survive a 14 Day mission in a Power 40 zone.

You can access Survive the Storm by selecting the Map tab and then selecting the Survive the Storm pin.

objectives.description: Complete a 14 Day Survive the Storm mission in a 40 zone

quest:survivalmodequest_14days_d3.name: Mission Literally Impossible
quest:survivalmodequest_14days_d3.description:
